snippet.title: Nightshade [Kunoichi] PS2 - ( PCSX2 ) - Long play - Playthrough - ( No Commentary )
snippet.description: Nightshade (in Japanese: くのいち; kunoichi, female ninja) is a direct sequel to Shinobi (2002) and was released in 2003 for the PlayStation 2. Developed by Overworks and published by Sega, Nightshade is the eleventh title in the Shinobi series. In Nightshade, players are introduced to Hibana, a government agent that must prevent the evil Nakatomi Conglomerate from collecting the shards of Akujiki, a powerful cursed blade, and releasing hell upon the world.
